articles.title: Anthropic Warns of Existential Risk, Liability and Slowing Sales
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s filing for a landmark initial public offering included nearly 100 pages of risk factors, an unusually exhaustive set of disclosures for how the company’s artificial intelligence business could go awry.The list included everything from slowing revenue growth and government regulation to “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity.” The scope of the risks hints at unique challenge public market investors face in gauging the promise and peril of Anthropic’s technology.

articles.title: Anthropic Grows More Reliant on Google, Amazon, Microsoft
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC is relying more and more on Alphabet Inc.’s Google, Amazon.com Inc. and Microsoft Corp. to sell its artificial intelligence technology to customers, despite the three companies being rivals, investors and key suppliers of computing power.

articles.title: Broadcom Arranges $63 Billion Deal to Finance Anthropic’s Chips
articles.summary: Chipmaker Broadcom Inc. has arranged a $63 billion deal with Bank of America Corp., Blackstone Inc., Citigroup Inc. and Morgan Stanley to finance the purchase of chips for AI model developer Anthropic PBC.

articles.title: What Anthropic’s IPO Reveals About the AI Boom: Live Q&A
articles.summary: Anthropic’s IPO is offering a rare look inside the business of frontier AI. Bloomberg journalists answer your questions in an interactive Live Q&A on Tuesday, Oct. 27 at 1 p.m. EDT.

articles.title: Anthropic Mum on Investment Grade as It Warns of More Debt
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC warned it may need to seek more financing sooner than the artificial-intelligence company had anticipated while saying little about its potential path to an investment-grade credit rating in its closely watched IPO filing.

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO Sets Up Defining Moment for Wall Street and AI Boom
articles.summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering is laying bare the stark extremes of the multi-trillion-dollar AI boom business model: astonishing growth paired with uncertainty about demand and the spending required to continue developing the technology. The startup, which publicly filed IPO paperwork on Monday, is poised to be the first major US firm focused solely on building AI software to make its market debut.

articles.title: Chinese video AI models beat US rivals in visual quality, but lag on safeguards: HKU study
articles.summary: Chinese AI video-generation models have surpassed leading US rivals in visual quality, but several fall behind in safety precautions, according to researchers at the University of Hong Kong. ByteDance’s Seedance 2.0 Pro took top spot in a ranking of 12 leading artificial intelligence video-generation models, scoring 3.84 out of 5 for visual quality. articles.title: 서강대, 네이버•코드프레소와 AI 역량 평가 협력 MOU 체결
articles.summary: [지디넷코리아] 이번 학기 AI 역량 평가 추진…진단 결과를 교육과 연계해 학생 역량 향상 지원 서울 대한민국, 2026년 10월 26일 /PRNewswire/ -- 서강대학교 AI중심대학은 10월 26일 네이버, 코드프레소와 AI역량평가 협력을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 세 기관은 이번 학기 AI 역량 평가 실시를 목표로 학생의 AI 역량을 체계적으로 진단하고, 산업 현장의 수요를 대학 교육에 반영하기 위한 협력을 추진한다. 이번 협약은 서강대의 AI 인재양성 기반에 기업의 기술•산업 경험을 접목해 교육의 실효성을 높이기 위해 마련됐다. 학생의 AI 기술 이해도와 활용 능력을 진단하고, 그 결과를 교육과 연계해 실질적인 역량 향상을 지원하는 것이 핵심이다. 서강대는 이번 학기 중 AI 역량 평가를 실시해 학생들의 역량 수준과 학습 수요를 파악할 계획이다. 평가 결과는 학생이 자신의 강점과 보완할 영역을 이해하고 학습 방향을 설정하는 데 활용된다. 대학은 이를 AI 교육과정
